final: WITH playlist_counts AS (SELECT p.PlaylistId, COUNT(pt.TrackId) AS track_count FROM Playlist AS p LEFT JOIN PlaylistTrack AS pt ON pt.PlaylistId = p.PlaylistId GROUP BY p.PlaylistId), avg_count AS (SELECT AVG(track_count) AS average_count FROM playlist_counts) SELECT pc.PlaylistId, pc.track_count, CAST(pc.track_count AS REAL) / ac.average_count AS ratio FROM playlist_counts AS pc CROSS JOIN avg_count AS ac ORDER BY ratio DESC NULLS LAST LIMIT 10
